prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 30s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, long straight chocolate brown hair — full body glazed ox-blood red porcelain fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid glazed porcelain curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted porcelain sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep ox-blood copper-red glaze across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID pale streaks and fine golden crackle lines running between the sections, with fine gold inlay lines tracing every joint between the sections, high-gloss glazed, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, a gold belly chain with a small pendant at her navel, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT porcelain — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a blurred ink-black gradient across the lids like soft smoke, a fine black liner, natural full lashes, a glass-skin highlight on the cheekbones, ink-black glossy lips with a softly blurred gradient edge.

Background: a cherry-blossom avenue in full bloom with a pale paved path strewn with petals, a waist-high wooden fence, a standard park bench and lamp posts, in warm golden late-afternoon light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
